dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem on tight bounds for $\lambda(d,s)$
dossier_meta.statement_text: Obtain tight bounds for $\lambda(d,s)$ for essentially all admissible values of $d$ and $s$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper proves several upper and lower bounds on $\lambda(d,s)$ and determines the exact set of $s$ for which $\lambda(d,s)=1$, but tight asymptotic characterisation of $\lambda(d,s)$ for general $s$ remains open.
